description: This source file defines the EpgRowsAdapter class, a RecyclerView adapter that displays rows of EPG programs for each channel in a TV guide-like interface. It manages creating view holders, binding channel data to rows, and initializing nested RecyclerViews for program listings.

classes.name: EpgRowsAdapter
classes.description: Adapter managing rows of EPG programs, tied to channels and their respective program lists.

classes.name: EpgRowsAdapter.RowVH
classes.description: ViewHolder class for a row containing a RecyclerView of programs.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates a new view holder for a row using the item_epg_row layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds a channel and its programs to the view holder by setting up the nested RecyclerView.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of channels.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Configures the nested RecyclerView with program data and layout manager.
